caption_fb:
Pasterka (pahs-TER-kah): the Shepherds' Mass at midnight.

After Wigilia supper, many Polish families walk to church for Mass at midnight, often through snow, often singing carols on the way. In villages the whole community gathers in the same church where their great-grandparents did.

If you ever stand in your family's parish church, you may be standing where they stood on Christmas night.

Merry Christmas from Seek the Cradle 🎄
